newsitem.title: USA: Telesensory drops IPO price range.
newsitem.headline: Telesensory drops IPO price range.

text.p: Telesensory Corp has lowered the estimated price range for shares in its proposed initial public offering to $8 to $10 a share, according to a regulatory filing.
The shares had initially been estimated to price in a range of $12 to $14 which was later dropped to $11 to $13 a share. The number of shares, 2.9 million, remains the same.
Jefferies & Co is the lead underwriter of the offering, which is due during the week of October 7.
Telesensory makes braille devices that allow blind people to use personal computers and the Aladdin family of video magnifiers for people with severely impaired vision.
